(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix archive-retention. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/archive-setup-grpc-api/.
id  tftypes.String computed
    description: The fixed id of this singleton: there is one per company.
retentions  nested LIST computed
    description: List of 4 retentions. The first retention is the default retention and can't be renamed.
retentions.editable  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Is the retention editable.
retentions.id  tftypes.String computed
    description: The retention id.
retentions.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: The retention name. If not set, the retention keeps its current name.
retentions.order  tftypes.Number computed
    description: The retention order. Computed by the order of the retention in the retentions list definition.
